description: A parent that emits one token over a quote and `bu` holds the quote's body as an opaque part. The part sounds `?` and gives its text, with the comma that no input token covers, so the token is labelled `zoi gy Hello, gy bu` (engine §5, §11). Each greedy stage's text is written with left recursion, so that the ranking sees where each piece ends (engine §3.3).

documents.g.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text ε | (text part)
%rule part letter | pause
%rule letter "z" :: Sound-007A-s := "z" | "o" :: Sound-006F-s := "o" | "i" :: Sound-0069-s := "i" | "g" :: Sound-0067-s := "g" | "y" :: Sound-0079-s := "y" | "b" :: Sound-0062-s := "b" | "u" :: Sound-0075-s := "u" | "a" :: Sound-0061-s := "a" | "c" :: Sound-0063-s := "c" | "H" :: Sound-0068-s := "h" | "e" :: Sound-0065-s := "e" | "l" :: Sound-006C-s := "l" %emits $ :: ($.tags ∪ L)



%rule pause ([","] $c:core [","]) %emits $c :: (P ∪ Sound-002E-s) := "." :- " "

%rule core core-char | (core core-char)
%rule core-char " " | "."
```
